$comment: Owned-surface manifest for the finance-tracker re-platform. Each parallel branch may ONLY modify paths in its own surface plus 'shared'. The merge gate's static stage rejects any diff outside a branch's declared manifest. Paths are git-style globs relative to repo root.

B1-backend-schema-money.notes: Adds TransactionSplit.is_refund, cents wire serializers, run_migrations entry. Routers untouched; existing router tests must stay green unchanged except where schemas change response field names per contract v2.

B2-backend-routers-service.notes: Extracts spend_service aggregation (S4) and adds category-type guard (S1). Builds on B1's schema changes.

F1-frontend-types-money.notes: Atomic cents migration across types+api+all pages (S3). Single PR, no partial states.

F2-frontend-decompose.notes: Move-only decomposition + style dedup (S5). No behaviour or styling change; verified by vitest suite staying green.

G-contract-tests.notes: Contract-seam test suite (S6) reading contracts/*.json as fixtures. Runs against main immediately; this is what makes the merge gate's contract-seam stage deterministic.

conflict_matrix.$comment: Files two branches both want = forbidden by manifests above. transactions.py is owned solely by B2; types.ts/api.ts solely by F1. This is why the DAG sequences instead of parallelising those.

gate_rules.static_owned_surface_check: git diff --name-only MERGE_BASE..HEAD must be subset of branch may_touch globs
gate_rules.suppression_guard: deleting contracts/ or tests/test_contract_seams.py fails the gate
